summary: 68-year-old New Mexico woman killed when her SUV rolled over her on the Dunes Parking Lot entrance road: she leaned back into the driver's door to unlock the rear hatch, knocked the transmission into neutral, and the vehicle rolled backward; she fell from it and the front left tire rolled over her. Ranger + firefighter/EMT resuscitation efforts were unsuccessful.
location: Dunes Parking Lot entrance road, Great Sand Dunes National Park
responding_agency: NPS rangers + Bandelier Fire Module firefighter/EMTs; Colorado State Patrol (accident reconstruction)
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry dated 2010-07-01; victim identified by initials M.A., 68, of Algodones, NM; her husband and two grandchildren were present and uninjured.
